channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Joe Johnson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Joe Johnson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Amen Thompson, Joe Johnson
item.description:
Draymond Green on Joe Johnson comments about Amen Thompson getting paid $200 million with no jump shot:

“I do think number one, you get paid for what you’ve done. I think there’s always this idea of you get paid for what you’re going to become. No, no. In this league you get paid for what you you’ve done. Amen Thompson has put together a body of work that says if you want to keep me, this is going to be the going rate. Now, yes, he needs to improve. But on the flip side, I do get a little frustrated sometimes when people come out like, “Yo, this guy can just gain a jump shot.”

Draymond Green on Amen Thompson, Joe Johnson, Sep 9, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Raja Bell, Joe Johnson
item.description:
Mike D'Antoni:

“And then Raja Bell got hurt (left calf in 2006 conference finals). What really ticks me off is that, and I don't know if we would’ve won or not, and I don’t know if we get to the finals or not, nobody knows, but the first year we tried, Joe Johnson breaks his orbital bone in his face (against the Mavs in the 2005 conference semifinals).And then the next year, Raja Bell gets hurt during the Dallas series. So, he's hobbled and hardly played or didn't play or wasn’t up to his usual self in the Western Conference Finals. And then the third year, we had the suspension.”

Mike D'Antoni on Raja Bell, Joe Johnson, Aug 15, 2026. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Joe Johnson
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Tatum on Joe Johnson:

“We all enjoyed the time that he was here... The ultimate professional and somebody a lot of us look up to and obviously, we would have loved to keep him around. I'm certain it was less about him and more about business.”

Jayson Tatum on Joe Johnson, Jan 4, 2022. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Joe Johnson
item.description:
From the way Casey spoke, the spot might be Johnson’s to lose.

“The need is there, but we also have a need for that veteran play like a Joe Johnson who can put the ball on the floor, still make plays, still shoot the ball,”

Dwane Casey on Joe Johnson, Sep 29, 2019. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Chris Paul on Joe Johnson
item.description:
Chris Paul on his relationship with former Jazzman Joe Johnson:

“We talk hoop all the time. If you watch basketball enough or play it enough, you sort of get a feel for what they like to do. I don’t think we can really do anything that’s going to surprise them.”

Chris Paul on Joe Johnson, May 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, Luol Deng, Joe Johnson
item.description:
“You know when you come to a new team it’s hard to find your spot at first. We had (Chris Bosh) at first, we had D-Wade, Joe Johnson, Luol Deng; there were a lot of players they were good and you just need time to adjust and fit into the system.“You could see the last year together we demonstrated we can play together.”

Goran Dragic on Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, Luol Deng, Joe Johnson, Feb 13, 2018. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Joe Johnson
item.description:
The NBA veteran will miss at least two weeks with tendon instability in his right wrist before being re-evaluated by team doctors.

“Unfortunately, we’re in a situation where Joe (Johnson) and Dante (Exum), a couple of our important players are out. It is what it is,”

Quin Snyder on Joe Johnson, Nov 2, 2017. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Joe Johnson
item.description:
Celtics head coach Brad Stevens informed the media Thursday afternoon that Jaylen Brown is in possession of a key trait that will push him in the right direction throughout his career.

“I thought Joe Johnson taught him quite a bit the other night,”

Brad Stevens on Joe Johnson, Jan 5, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Joe Johnson
item.description:
Wade, on Heat addition Joe Johnson, who cleared waivers in the past hour and whose addition was confirmed on Twitter by owner Micky Arison:

“To put somebody on the floor that can shoot the ball, can score in different areas of the floor and make plays, just adds to what we're trying to do. Joe is a friend of mine. I tried to do my best to paint the picture that this is a good place to be, and the decision from there is his. Make sure he sees my name in his in-box a lot. He made the decision what's best for them... Open arms in Miami for him.... Losing Chris [Bosh] right now... in games like this you really get to see you're missing your All-Star.”

Dwyane Wade on Joe Johnson, Feb 28, 2016. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Lionel Hollins on Joe Johnson
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Hollins on Joe Johnson:

“I think the one thing he might not have said and take back, I think he’d take back was saying 'selfish.'”

Lionel Hollins on Joe Johnson, Nov 12, 2014. Source: Twitter @nydninternets.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Joe Johnson, Deron Williams
item.description:
“But I think they're still at the top of their games. I think Paul is still one of those guys who can go off for big nights and still have big scoring nights. Kevin is a culture change. He won't play but 20 to 25 minutes a night and there'll probably be nights when he doesn't play but his presence there alone will absolutely change the culture of Brooklyn. There's no doubt about it. I think for some of the young guys, even some of the veteran stars, Joe Johnson and Deron Williams, will learn and understand what a winner is and looks like and professionalism and being prepared.”

Doc Rivers on Joe Johnson, Deron Williams, Jul 28, 2013. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: PJ Carlesimo on Joe Johnson
item.description:
“It would be scary to think what this year would’ve been like without Joe Johnson,”

PJ Carlesimo on Joe Johnson, Apr 29, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: PJ Carlesimo on Joe Johnson
item.description:
Responding to a question during a Sunday conference call about how critics think Johnson is too reliant on isolation plays, settles for too many jumpers and isn’t worthy of his max contract, Carlesimo replied,

“It’s hard to be polite and answer the question.‘Critic’ is such an ambiguous term. I would call them uniformed or basketball unintelligent. Everybody’s entitled to their opinion. It would be hard for me to think that there was an intelligent basketball person making a statement like that about Joe Johnson.”

PJ Carlesimo on Joe Johnson, Apr 29, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Joe Johnson
item.description:
“I mean, honestly, I got an opportunity to talk to their owner and talk to coach (Avery) Johnson. I had a great meeting with those guys … I'm happy where I landed. I'm happy I'm here.”

LeBron James on Joe Johnson, Nov 8, 2012. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Jordan Crawford on Joe Johnson, Deron Williams
item.description:
Michael Lee:Jordan Crawford said BKN have NBA's best backcourt:

“Vicious. The only word to describe it. Deron [Williams] is like a 6-2 Joe Johnson.”

Jordan Crawford on Joe Johnson, Deron Williams, Jul 24, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mikhail Prokhorov on Avery Johnson, Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King
item.description:
Prokhorov said in the statement.

“My congratulations and appreciation go out to general manager Billy King, assistant general manager Bobby Marks and head coach Avery Johnson for their tenacity, nerve and heart throughout this process. With the re-signing of Deron Williams and the trade for Joe Johnson, we go into our new home led by an All-Star backcourt and with every hope of a great season for the Brooklyn Nets. I can’t wait until opening night.”

Mikhail Prokhorov on Avery Johnson, Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King, Jul 13, 2012. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mikhail Prokhorov on Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King
item.description:
Mikhail Prokhorov:

“I'm thrilled with the way our team has come together. My congratulations and appreciation go out to General Manager Billy King, Assistant General Manager Bobby Marks and Head Coach Avery Johnsonfor their tenacity, nerve and heart throughout this process. With the re-signing of Deron Williams and the trade for Joe Johnson, we go into our new home led by an All-Star backcourt and with every hope of a great season for the Brooklyn Nets. I can't wait until opening night.”

Mikhail Prokhorov on Joe Johnson, Bobby Marks, Deron Williams, Billy King, Jul 12, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Billy King on Joe Johnson
item.description:
“We are very pleased to add a perennial All-Star caliber player like Joe Johnson to our roster,”

Billy King on Joe Johnson, Jul 11, 2012. Source: Newark Star-Ledger.

item.title: Deron Williams on Joe Johnson
item.description:
Williams said at Team USA training camp.

“I actually thought that's where I was going to go. I had the meetings and it kind of changed my mind because once I got out of the meeting with Dallas and saw the way they way were going and the team they were putting out there and I saw that we just made a trade for Joe Johnson and I felt like that team for a longer time would be the better team.”

Deron Williams on Joe Johnson, Jul 6, 2012. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Larry Drew on Joe Johnson
item.description:
Larry Drew on Whether or not Joe Johnson is a money player:

“Joe Johnson is definitely a money player. I think in the crunch time situations that’s when he is at his best. Right now he is playing good basketball and Tuesday night hopefully he will put together his best game of the series so we can finish this thing off.”

Larry Drew on Joe Johnson, Apr 26, 2011. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.
